advancements.jaymospowers.pack.story.des: Tell the story of who you were.
advancements.jaymospowers.pack.first_ran: Work a town's job until it gives you a rank.
advancements.jaymospowers.pack.sworn.des: Kneel at a shrine and swear yourself to a patron.
Stand before one of the old stones.
advancements.jaymospowers.pack.giant.des: Bring down what wakes beside the stone.
advancements.jaymospowers.pack.aether.de: Find your way to the land above.
advancements.jaymospowers.pack.giant_two: Fell a second kind of Giant.
advancements.jaymospowers.pack.giant_all: Fell every kind of Giant there is.
advancements.jaymospowers.pack.cooked.de: Cook a dish at a hob, grill or oven.
advancements.jaymospowers.pack.perfect_d: Cook a dish without a single slip.
Take a ship out under your own hand.
advancements.jaymospowers.pack.insight.d: Unlock an entry in the alchemist's codex.
advancements.jaymospowers.pack.forged.de: Hold a tool you put together from parts.
advancements.jaymospowers.pack.execution: Finish a foe who lies helpless before you.
advancements.jaymospowers.pack.errands.d: Do three errands for the folk of a town.
advancements.jaymospowers.pack.long_defe: Find a copy of the gate-warden's book.
